analysis: Existing baseline only; no new hardware operation or component attribution
scope: Power delivered through JS from regulated 5 V, including populated Nucleo overhead; D2/R23 removed, U24 fitted. Not battery/LTC energy.
window_qualification: First 5 ms and whole-cycle raw integrals remain unqualified. All separately bounded post-5-ms analog samples finite and contiguous; original 71 startup NaNs remain in the whole-session evidence.
marker_semantics: For the installed magic-slot path, legacy phase 7 padded_payload_ready is emitted after successful whole-slot transport return, not the first available image buffer. Frame IRQ is not sensor power-off.
peak_definition: Mean current in 1 ms or 10 ms windows, searched every 0.1 ms after the excluded first 5 ms. Three highest nonoverlapping windows per width. Native extrema are not qualified physical peaks.
causal_limit: A phase change is correlation. All components remain on the shared measured rail; compare controlled ablations to determine incremental loads.
